children: Host Digital announced a signed 15-year, take-or-pay lease for Site I covering 55 MW gross capacity and about $1.25 billion in contracted base-term rent.
Signed 15-year take-or-pay lease for Site I providing 55 MW gross capacity and ~43 MW critical IT capacity.
Lease totals approximately $1.25 billion base-term rent with 3% annual increases; first-year contracted rent ~ $67M.
Targeting facility delivery in Q1 2027; rent begins upon delivery after financing, design, buildout and testing complete.
Site I has existing power, building, and utility substation; Host invested ~$40M to date and raised $17.5M in recent offering.
Host’s RightScaled model (20–100 MW) aims to secure project-level financing tied to leases and expand pipeline (450+ MW potential).

title: Host Digital details $1.25B 15-year lease for 55MW Site I; targets Q1 2027 delivery
